fact: SONSA published a 20-page research report on AI and digital rights in Somalia carried out by Capital University of Somalia, analysing government policies and private sector practices.
system: Artificial Intelligence and Digital Rights in Somalia

fact: SONSA Platform, Mogadishu, published a policy brief evaluating Somalia's National ICT Policy and Strategy and recommending a 2025-2030 revision.
SIDRA Institute, a Garowe-based think tank, published Policy Brief 26 on cybersecurity in Somalia by its researcher Abdi Omar Bile.

The Heritage Institute for Policy Studies published in May 2023 'Digital ID: Prospects and Challenges for Somalia', an interview- and document-based study finding legal and infrastructure readiness inadequate.
